title: Fixed Opposed Four Arch Crowns and Waisted Vajra
description: One newly authored complete uninscribed vajra-inspired cultural ornament, shown in a fixed horizontal side-rest pose. The open-cage dumbbell instead encloses its grip within a straight rectangular rail chamber between solid end blocks; the twin-cage beater places two parallel crossed loops below a bearing frame and geared crank.
